notes.title: Boon Boon Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I am Anamik, an indie game developer and I am really glad to announce that Boon Boon game will be released on [b]12th July, 2019[/b] and it has been officially confirmed. Thanks to everyone who wishlisted the game and shown your interest in my small game project. 

I have put a lot of effort into making this game and I really hope that you will enjoy it. 

If you have any feedback or suggestion to improve the game please feel free to let me know. 

Thanks to the Steam community for the continuous support! This game would not have exist without your support. Thanks again!

Play and Enjoy!

Kind Regards,
Anamik
